body:
Implementation and test v1 are frozen and retained as exact source snapshots. Independent review found two final-time qualification gaps; both were corrected before execution. Account 2000ms, metadata 30000ms, recovery 3000ms, rate limits and action bounds remain unchanged.

The first actual compile failed with E0716 in the new test's temporary position_reports borrow; no tests executed. The correction holds the original returned map without changing business assertions. Focused validation at 2026-10-09 09:22:07-09:22:20 UTC then passed all 19 new source sealing/reuse/fallback/history/freshness scenarios. Exact source, commands, failed output and successful output are retained. Full native regression, official stubs, wheel and normal installed-node acceptance are pending.

Review additionally found that startup fallback must not ignore a newly observed HTTP selected-metadata counterproof. A startup-only strict source qualification and three actual HTTP-only row-conflict cases are being added. Ordinary account publication is unchanged; an unrequested future response is not an observed counterproof. No checklist is marked complete, and application issue 43 / real-venue acceptance remain open.

The initial version of this comment was corrupted by PowerShell stdin encoding. Its exact failed payload is retained locally, and this corrected body is read from a UTF-8 file.

The actual selected HTTP row counterproofs first failed against the unqualified fallback (0 passed / 3 failed at 09:29:07-09:29:11 UTC). A startup-only requirement for a newly qualified complete source after a real full read fixed that observed gap. Ordinary account publication remains unchanged. The 22 new cases then passed, followed by all 55 original startup cases; their 11 future-HTTP setups intentionally use a genuine applied identical private frame to force the actual faulty read. The original Cache metadata counterproof is retained.

Full Hyperliquid v5 regression passed 1387 tests at 09:31:55-09:36:09 UTC. Twelve native tests and six doc tests are ignored. Independent execution of immutable source-bound v5 binaries passed 184 distinct selected tests at 09:40:06-09:41:25 UTC, with all 39 source and two executable identities unchanged. This overlaps the full regression and is not an additional 184 unique product cases. Its hard-history test observed one actual history request; the zero-request deadline branch is not independently claimed.

Production strict Clippy passed. The test-inclusive command found two newly introduced style diagnostics and ten inherited test diagnostics (four library-test and six integration-test). Only the two new diagnostics were corrected. Final v6 test-inclusive Clippy still reports the ten inherited diagnostics; no blanket lint pass is claimed. Independent source review verified that v6 changes only those two test styles and preserves the v5 production bytes and every business assertion. Final v6 regression, official stubs, clean-source wheel/install, normal installed-node and the application paired retry are still in progress. No finite checklist is marked complete yet.

The first application 43 paired retry on the clean issue 115 candidate was actually executed at 10:11:46.206245–10:12:04.739496 UTC on 2026-10-09. It remains **FAIL**, rather than paired acceptance. All original native assertions and 2-second account/action, 3-second recovery, 15-second run, 5-second cleanup, action/read/event/evidence caps remain unchanged.

The corrected synthetic peer executes an immutable trade before its Filled ACK. Its original 150 ms delay now delays publication only. Four real numeric-loopback HTTP/WS peer tests pass, including overlapping entry/reduce-close and reject, cleanup rejection and an explicitly unexecuted missing-response fault. Final application guard checks passed 156 cases with seven actual-installed cases deselected; the four new peer cases are included in 156. Final Ruff checks pass. Earlier missing-tool and style failures remain retained.

On the actual installed ordinary native candidate, both legs entered and closed: four genuine fills entered the controller and native Cache, all four orders became FILLED, both controller positions and native Portfolio net positions are zero, and gross/unhedged reservations are zero. Wire actions were Hyperliquid 2 and Aster 3; controller actions were 6, including prepared cancellation. Shutdown was verified, watchdog did not fire, and no runtime exception was recorded. The finite controller nevertheless ended `StoppedUnknown`, with current projection and owned-flat proof still Unknown.

After the Hyperliquid close, the real warm query received open-order/fill/status responses but later prerequisite reads did not finish within its original 3-second total deadline. Source debt and conservative refusal are retained. Successful fills and zero Portfolio position do not establish a current complete scoped-account proof. No retry, TTL extension, quota relaxation, fabricated financial event, or debt clearing was used.

Candidate implementation: `617ffd42eeed6e8e5fff2ec36c10e25f0de1fcbe`; source fingerprint `739bb0507e1e320f4d35467537d02eee1139a478c6a5f7ccda4090e2b2288905`; wheel SHA-256 `7ea01172ddb8f7bc985edcf5641b62b1d4fc0e4704d79a68d0dc615d3926d748`; installed pyd SHA-256 `2ab428c99dd5c676b1afa09a34e66ee3ef4d37f308f4a413b3f1ea136801fa81`. All 57 current source, installed and artifact identities were unchanged across this attempt. The application's formal candidate lock was unchanged.

Native issue 115 separately passed 1,387 local Hyperliquid cases (12 pre-existing native tests and six doctests ignored), 242 installed Python cases, official 44-stub comparison, production Clippy, independent copied-binary checks and a normal installed read-only LiveNode probe. Test-inclusive Clippy retains ten inherited diagnostics; make checks cannot launch on this host. The independent read-only probe used its own 30-second TTL and does not substitute for this application retry.

This completes the required actual retry evidence for issue 115's finite startup-source contract; PR and exact-head CI are still pending. Application 43/E6, real venue execution, whole-account economics, durable cold Cache recovery and kernel isolation remain incomplete. Any subsequent recovery implementation will start from newly merged main in a separate issue/worktree. The complete failed run and prior failed revisions are being archived without changing their bytes.
